comparison.objective: Open a cabinet, hang two assigned key rings on hooks, seat the blades in guides, and close the door; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires small-ring threading, guide insertion, object release, and door articulation, rather than driver/wrench counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Checks assigned hook capture, millimetric final key poses, low contact, and closed released door over 20 controls; candidate checks opening angle, retained hardware, repeated cycling, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Precision key hanging and cabinet closure do not test adjustment retention under locknut torque.
